title: 14-Day Ultimate Kenya & Tanzania Safari Experience
shortDescription: The grand East African safari uniting Maasai Mara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Amboseli, Lake Manyara, and Samburu in an epic two-week adventure.
fullDescription: Immerse yourself in the definitive East African safari. Traverse across the savannahs of Kenya and Tanzania, tracking the Big 5, witnessing the Great Wildebeest Migration, encountering huge elephant herds beneath Mount Kilimanjaro, and descending into the geological marvel of Ngorongoro Crater with dedicated private 4x4 Land Cruisers and expert naturalist guides.
